nom: Eucerin Radiant Tone Night Cream Dark Spot Corrector

segments.dry: Reviewers with dry or winter-dry skin describe the cream as strongly moisturizing and non-drying, with one calling it helpful for 'horrible dry skin' and another noting it is gentle and doesn't dry the face out.
segments.sensitive: Sensitive-skin reviewers mostly report no irritation or breakouts, though the fragrance is separately flagged by several other reviewers as a source of allergic reaction or discomfort.
segments.mature: One reviewer references age spots and lack-of-sleep marks and reports the eye area looking more refreshed after use, and another still awaits results on wrinkles.

concerns.aging: Reviewers mention fine lines, wrinkles and 'age spots' alongside dark spots; most report brighter, firmer-looking skin, but at least one reviewer is still 'waiting to see' if it helps wrinkles.
concerns.dehydration: Widely reported as moisturizing, soft, plump and hydrated the next morning; one reviewer says it did not provide the hydration her skin needed and one found repeated daily use too drying for her face.
concerns.barrier: Not discussed as a distinct barrier concern; reviewers close to this topic describe no irritation or breakouts rather than barrier repair specifically.
concerns.spots: The majority report visible fading or lightening of dark spots, freckles, sun spots, or hyperpigmentation within two to four weeks; several say it is too soon to tell, and a few report no noticeable change even after a month of use.
concerns.blemishes: One reviewer with old acne scars and dark spots reports no irritation or new breakouts; another separately reports no breakouts while awaiting results on wrinkles.
concerns.oiliness: Reviewers consistently describe the formula as non-greasy and absorbing without oily residue, with no reports of increased oiliness.

aspects.libelle: Pills or clumps under other products
Good value versus pricier night creams

extraits.texte: I am beyond shocked that this product has a fragrance. Fragrance irritates skin and Eucerin knows this! I have come to rely on this brand to be one of the best for my skin. Not any longer. I immediately washed my face after applying and threw the sample away. I will let my dermatologist know NOT to recommend this product! And I will definitely rethink my use of this brand going forward. So disappointing!

extraits.titre: Fragrance is very strong, almost unbearable.
extraits.texte: I've been using this product for the past couple nights now. Feels very hydrating, and I am looking forward to seeing if it makes a dent in treating my melasma. I am finding it a little difficult to get past the strong fragrance. I'll probably continue using this product until the bottle finishes, but I probably won't be repurchasing. Is it possible to reformulate this product without that odor?

I have only used this for a couple weeks, but I really love it. It goes on smooth, non-greasy, absorbs well. No issues with my sensitive skin. I haven't noticed much difference in dark spots, but maybe it takes a little more time. Will continue to use. I received this product free in exchange for my honest opinion.

extraits.titre: It does work for dark spots!
extraits.texte: So I received this a free sample and I'm quite surprised! I've already noticed a dark spot I have on the side of my nose getting much lighter! Wouldn't use it every single day because it would dry my face too much but I'm very satisfied and would highly recommend!
I received this free Eucerin Radiant Tone Night Cream Dark Spot Corrector . It works great on my dark spot, it's gentle on my dry skin doesn't dry out , but I see some good results in 2 weeks.

extraits.titre: Eucerin Radiant Tone Night Cream Dark Spot Corrector
extraits.texte: I received this product from pinchme in return for my honest opinion. I really liked this product, I have horrible dry skin and this has absolutely helped. Highly recommend.
My face is so soft and moisturizer, I haven't had any breakouts either. Waiting to see if it helps with my wrinkles and dark spots.
